versions.changelog:
Initial release — comprehensive game architecture design toolkit.

- Provides step-by-step process for designing scalable game architectures: system mapping, dependency diagrams, ADRs, and data flow documentation.
- Includes ready-to-use document structure for organizing architecture files and decision records.
- Features templates for mapping system dependencies, creating architecture decision records (ADRs), and documenting data flows.
- Offers multi-platform guidance for using different LLMs and coding tools to generate and navigate architecture documents.
- Covers core architecture patterns, system interaction diagrams, and performance budgeting as part of the workflow.
- Designed to produce clear, maintainable, and scalable architecture documentation for game development projects.
